---
title: "check-self-contained-captions.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags a figure or table caption
whose first sentence only points to another div.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-26) is that a caption states
what the float shows, so it stands alone.
A cross-reference may support the claim and never replaces it.
This implements
[gha#1237](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1237).

A caption is the last paragraph of a `#fig-` or `#tbl-` div,
a one-line `#| fig-cap:` or `#| tbl-cap:` chunk option,
or a pipe-table caption line `: Caption {#tbl-x}`.
Its first sentence is flagged when it holds a cross-reference and,
with the reference, inline code and link URLs removed,
it has fewer than four words or ends on a word that needs a complement
("of", "at", "the", ...).
A trailing ", as in @x" or "(see @x)" is support, not a defect.
A long first sentence (eight words or more) may end on "of @x"
and still say what the float shows.
A table caption is a noun-phrase title,
so "Estimated coefficients for @eq-x" passes.
Only a first sentence under three words is flagged there.
"The symmetry of @exm-logistic-symmetry." is flagged.
"The logistic function at -2 is as high as one minus its value at 2
(@exm-logistic-symmetry)." passes.

A justified exception carries a reason:
an HTML comment `<!-- caption-ref: reason -->` inside the div exempts it.
Use `paths-ignore` to exempt whole paths.

## Scope

Only a float that holds a line a pull request adds is reported,
so existing captions are never reflagged.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to measure how many existing captions would be flagged.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`     | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`        | Fail the workflow when a caption only points to another div. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-self-contained-captions.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a caption that only points to another div when a PR
# adds a line to its float. Say what the float shows, or add
# <!-- caption-ref: reason --> in the div.
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check self-contained captions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-self-contained-captions.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                        # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every file, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-self-contained-captions.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-self-contained-captions.yml)
for the full caller stub.
